 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 12-07-2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP Mr. Pramod kumar Pandey for the State .

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A,
341 , 323 , 379 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code .
3 . It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of mediation vide mediation report dated 24.06.2024 .
4. Learned A.P.P does not dispute with the contention made on behalf of the petitioner.

5 . Considering the aforesaid fact that dispute between the parties has already been resolved, in the event of arrest or Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82505 of 2023(4) dt.12-07-2024 surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond Raushan Kumar @ Deepak Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73255831/
1 of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court of Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate , Nalanda at Bihar sharif in connection with Mahila P S Case No. 21 of 2022 , subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure .
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Koushik/-
